Built from the ground up to make investing simple, secure, and accessible to everyone — whether you have never touched crypto or manage a large portfolio.

🔒Security

How It Works

From sign-up to your first investment — four simple steps, no paperwork needed.

01

Create Your Free Account

Sign up in under a minute with just your email. Your account is immediately secured with encryption and optional two-factor authentication.

02

Deposit Funds

Already have crypto / digital assets? Send USDT directly. New to digital assets? No worries — we guide you step-by-step to buy USDT with your debit card or bank transfer.

03

Pick a Fund & Invest

Choose from our range of professionally structured index funds and start investing — no identity verification required. Verify later to unlock higher limits.

04

Watch Your Wealth Grow

Track your portfolio with live price updates, detailed performance charts, and a full breakdown of every asset in your funds. Every transaction is verifiable on the blockchain.

Built for Trust

Every security measure below is actively protecting your account and assets right now. We earn your trust through real protection, not just promises.

✅

1:1 Asset Backed — Always

When you invest in a fund, your money directly purchases every asset in it. No IOUs, no synthetics. Every purchase is recorded on the blockchain and verifiable through our public vault address at any time.

🏦

Multi-Signature Vault

🔐

Your password is encrypted and your account is protected. Enable two-factor authentication for an extra layer of security on every login.

🌍

Fiat Friendly — For Everyone

New to crypto / digital assets? We guide you on how to deposit using your bank card and how to withdraw back to your local currency. No technical knowledge required.

⚙️

Encrypted Data Storage

All your personal and financial data is encrypted using industry-standard methods. Your information is protected at every level of the platform.

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers to the most common questions. For more, visit our Support Center.

Wealtii is a digital asset investment platform that lets you invest in diversified index funds. Each fund holds a balanced mix of top digital assets, giving you broad market exposure with a single investment. We offer a comprehensive suite of digital asset index funds, spanning Bitcoin, Ethereum, and tokenized real-world assets like stocks, gold, and silver.

Each index fund holds a carefully selected mix of digital assets in specific proportions. When you invest, your money is used to purchase the actual underlying assets — all 1:1 backed and verifiable on the blockchain. Fund values update in real-time based on live market prices.

No — you can create an account and start investing right away without submitting any documents. Identity verification is completely optional and simply unlocks higher transaction limits as your portfolio grows.

Absolutely! You do not need to know anything about crypto. We guide you step-by-step on how to buy USDT using your debit card or bank transfer directly inside the platform. When you want to cash out, we also show you exactly how to convert back to your local currency.

Yes — 100%. When you invest in a fund, your money is used to purchase every asset in that fund. Nothing synthetic, no IOUs. Every transaction is recorded on the blockchain and you can verify it anytime through our public vault address.

All platform assets are held in a secure multi-signature vault on the blockchain that requires multiple authorized approvals for any withdrawal. Your account is further protected by encryption, secure sessions, and optional two-factor authentication.

Wealtii charges simple, transparent fees with no hidden costs. All fees are clearly shown before you confirm any transaction. There are no account setup or maintenance fees — you only pay when you invest or withdraw.

Yes. You can request a withdrawal at any time. Withdrawals are processed through our secure multi-signature authorization system and typically complete within a few minutes. Need cash in your bank? We guide you on how to convert back to your local currency too.

Identity verification (KYC) is an optional process to confirm who you are. We offer multiple levels — higher levels unlock larger transaction limits. All documents are securely encrypted and handled with strict privacy.

Yes. We are starting with digital asset index funds and already expanding into tokenized real-world assets — including stocks (like Apple and Google), gold, silver, and more — all on the blockchain. One platform for all your investments.

Your future self will thank you.

Be among the first to choose simple, transparent, and fully-backed digital asset index funds over complicated alternatives. No crypto experience needed — start in minutes. Enjoy 0% fees for a limited time.

✓ 1:1 asset backed✓ No KYC to start✓ Fiat friendly✓ Withdraw anytime

Wealtii does not provide financial advice. Please ensure you fully understand the risks involved and invest only what you can afford to lose.
